status_label: Completed & Verified — Phase 2 Official HuggingFace Weights & Software-vs-RTL Comparison Published

reviewer_decisions.reason:
The Phase 2 engineering delivery is accepted within the admitted bounded-checkpoint scope. The selectable RMS epsilon is implemented consistently, and the recorded complete checks support the official-weight software-versus-RTL comparison without relaxing its numerical limits. This accepts the engineering work, not a final product report or native full-model equivalence.

I read the normalization RTL, parameter routes through top and participating wrappers, parameter-aware integer model, official BF16 parser and remapping, independent floating operators, tensor graph, public-pin testbench, scoreboards, mutation checks and synthesis inspection code. RMS_EPSILON_Q80 is unsigned 128-bit, retains the legacy default 17<<56 and propagates through every normalization engine. Official configurations select the predetermined value 1208925819614629175. Only the RMS denominator addition uses it; L2 remains epsilon-free. The complete functional execution includes 66 norm-vector comparisons and 30 observed unchanged-L2 pairs, as well as the retained synthetic regressions.

The current comparison is evidence/verification/functional/1792082720920298364-239674/official_weights_comparison.json, explicitly linked by its execution receipt. All 29 predetermined official cases completed across the three modes and required output dimensions, with zero integer/RTL output mismatches and exact scratch-address/write-history comparisons. The lowest recorded cosine is 0.9999999950454138; the largest component error is 0.000047340989112854004, both from B vision-only. The recorded norm errors and software/RTL norm differences also satisfy 0.002. MAE, RMSE, vector distance, separate norms and measured first/final/completion latencies are retained. Both B cases observe 20 distinct patch vectors, axial positions, multi-key attention and pooling participant counts 9/6/3/2. I inspected their raw output and completion transcripts, including the formerly unreached joint execution. B vision-only completes at 225097 descriptor-relative cycles and joint at 284593 cycles, using the documented 10ns simulated clock.

The shared-runtime functional, sensitivity and synthesis commands all completed with exit 0 and empty outer stderr. Their sources do more than print success: output words and scratch histories are compared, malformed or incomplete transcripts fail, and five compiling/executing mutations are rejected by concrete scratch or output mismatches. The sensitivity receipt is evidence/verification/sensitivity/1792083140419170018-250999/receipt.json. Real Yosys synthesis for A and C is retained at evidence/verification/synthesis/1792083152490622108-251812/receipt.json; its checker traverses connected hierarchy, verifies epsilon propagation, sequential state, no latches and no unresolved modules. Both raw Yosys logs report zero structural problems. The recorded tools include Icarus Verilog 12.0 and Yosys 0.33.

The original numerical failure remains at evidence/preparation/phase2-official-multipatch-20261015-005/: its complete transcript and comparison retain cosine 0.9913286747181946 and maximum error 0.06919039785861969 despite exact integer agreement. The failed 008 norm preparation is also retained, with 009 explicitly linked as its repair; current code runs every norm case before returning. These advisory records have not been substituted for the complete checks.

The claim remains a scaled, explicitly remapped official-weight subnetwork evaluation. Supplied-provenance consistency is not independent remote authentication; decoded BF16 weights with binary32 operator boundaries and binary64 reductions are not native BF16 arithmetic. Native full-checkpoint inference, physical timing and default-model throughput are not established. Historical fixed-path comparison files remain separate from the current execution-local result. I ran no commands and changed no files. Final product reporting may now proceed through the shared runtime's separate review.

The timing-repaired Phase 2 engineering delivery is accepted within the admitted bounded-checkpoint scope. Fresh results support the software-versus-RTL comparison with unchanged numerical limits. This does not approve the final product report or establish physical timing closure.

I inspected the serial divider, constant reciprocal helper, registered series, nonlinear and rotary consumers, address calculations, verification entry point, public-pin scoreboard, divider tests, mutation checks and synthesis inspection. Runtime division is replaced by registered arithmetic; exact quotient/remainder outputs preserve argument-reduction semantics. The divider tests independently calculate nearest-even results, signed truncating quotients and remainders, and check stalled-output stability. The fresh functional run compared 3,408 serial divisions, 5,698 constant divisions and 456 nonlinear cases. These are executed assertions, not just printed success labels.

The current comparison is evidence/verification/functional/1792408168716575019-1542535/official_weights_comparison.json, linked from its receipt. All 29 fixed official cases completed with zero integer/RTL output mismatches and exact scratch-address/write-history comparisons. The lowest cosine is 0.9999999950454138 and largest component error is 0.000047340989112854004; both satisfy the original thresholds. The retained synthetic matrix includes B/C seeds 17 and 89, required prefixes, epsilon/L2 comparisons and protocol regressions. Raw B transcripts show 12 output beats, successful completion and equal request/response counts. Refreshed descriptor-to-completion measurements are 650,081 cycles for B vision-only and 804,367 for B joint—6,500,810 ns and 8,043,670 ns at the documented simulated 10 ns clock. Earlier cycle counts must not describe the repaired design.

The host-recorded functional, sensitivity and synthesis commands completed successfully. evidence/verification/sensitivity/1792408951152184438-1591396/receipt.json records five compiling, executing mutations rejected by concrete scratch or embedding mismatches. evidence/verification/synthesis/1792408970020293643-1592384/receipt.json records real Yosys A/C runs, each with 36 reachable modules, substantive sequential state, zero latches and no runtime divide/modulo cells. Its source checker rejects clocked blocking assignments and tests its own detection examples. Both raw Yosys logs report zero structural problems. The current shared-runtime rtl-timing-lint result also reports no division/modulo or mixed-assignment hazards across 21 RTL files. Recorded tools are Python 3.12.3, Icarus/vvp 12.0 and Yosys 0.33.

The earlier numerical failures remain linked rather than replaced by preparation successes. Previously accepted, unchanged parser/remapping and numerical requirements retain their bounded interpretation: these measurements use a scaled, explicitly remapped official-weight subnetwork, not native full-model inference or native BF16 arithmetic. Remote checkpoint authentication, physical timing and default-model throughput are not established. I executed no commands and changed no files. The shared runtime may proceed to separate final-report review using the fresh results.
